scope: Community and regional food systems planning, resilience, equity, and public-land urban agriculture policy

records.name: American Planning Association Food Systems KnowledgeBase
records.description: Curated planning collection covering community and regional food systems, including plans, policies, model codes, reports, case studies, training, maps, toolkits, and examples of local recommendations.
records.availability_notes: This is a curated research and policy collection rather than direct technical assistance or funding. Linked plans, codes, and examples may vary in date, jurisdiction, and current legal applicability. Verified August 6, 2026.

records.name: A Planner's Guide to Community and Regional Food Planning
records.description: American Planning Association PAS Report 554 on food environments, healthy-food access, planning and zoning, community examples, measurement, and planning strategies.
records.availability_notes: Published October 15, 2008. Full access may require APA membership or purchase. Use as a foundational planning reference and verify current laws, programs, data, and terminology before application. Verified August 6, 2026.

records.name: Local Food Systems Key to Healthy, Resilient, Equitable Communities
records.description: Planning Magazine article explaining how local and regional food systems can advance resilience, equity, economic development, food access, environmental goals, food sovereignty, and food-business incubation.
records.availability_notes: Published February 1, 2021. This is an educational article, not a current program directory. Examples and statistics should be checked against newer local and primary sources before use. Verified August 6, 2026.

records.name: ChangeLab Solutions: Dig, Eat, & Be Healthy
records.description: Guide and model legal resource for growing food on public property, including site inventories, access processes, leases, licenses, interagency agreements, liability, utilities, maintenance, contamination, security, improvements, and school-property issues.
records.availability_notes: This is general policy and model-document guidance, not legal advice. Agreements and recommendations must be adapted to Indiana law, local ordinances, agency authority, environmental conditions, insurance, and site-specific risks with qualified review. Verified August 6, 2026.
